name: fuel_oil_boiler_onoff_setpoint
title: Fuel-oil boiler with on/off envelope losses and a set-point blend (theta)
summary: Exercise of a fuel-oil boiler: combustion stoichiometry and adiabatic flame temperature with cpbar, a gas-water eps-NTU exchanger with assigned gas-side specific heat, a water-envelope exchanger with ON and OFF branches, and the exercise-3 set-point outlet blending the ON and OFF outlets with a fraction theta (default run theta = 1).
